submitted.rationale: Of the five compositions measured, index 12 (Sb fraction 0.411) had the highest EQE at 0.84%. EQE rises from the Ni-rich end (index 3: 0.078%, index 8: 0.49%) to a peak near Sb 0.4, then collapses on the Sb-rich side at and beyond NiSb2O6 (index 20: 0.013%, index 27: 0.014%). The peak probably lies somewhere between Sb 0.35 and 0.60.
